patch_description: All four starts currently begin from exact lattice seed positions, so they often converge into the same basin and waste the multi-start budget. Jittering each start's centers with a small Gaussian perturbation (seeded per start) decorrelates the basins cheaply while preserving the strong hex-lattice structure that already works well. Also add extra jittered variants of the best-performing seed type, since variants of a strong base outperform diverse layouts. Additionally, add mild inflation moves to the annealer (occasionally pushing a circle away from its nearest neighbor) to help escape stalls faster.
